openFindings.title: The automatic nudge names a note path in a directory it never creates
openFindings.description: plannedNotePath builds the handoff note path but never creates the handoffs directory; only /speckit:handoff does.
openFindings.scopeProof: All five automatic adapters route through plannedNotePath; no mkdir exists in nudge or the adapters.

openFindings.title: A second handoff can orphan the first open note and a later nudge can reuse the stale path
openFindings.description: prepare overwrites the loop record and supersedeClaimed only closes claimed notes, while openNotePathFor returns the first open note in directory order.
openFindings.scopeProof: The two planners disagree and no test covers two open notes for one session.

openFindings.title: Handoff notes inherit the default permissive directory and file modes
openFindings.description: The handoffs directory is only joined, not created with a private mode, and writeHandoffUpdate preserves the existing note mode.
openFindings.scopeProof: All handoff writers use the same directory and the same preserved mode; no note mode pin exists.

openFindings.title: Phase 007 cites a live-run log that is absent and permanently ignored by Git
openFindings.description: AC-006 to AC-008 cite relaunch-run10.log by line; the file is absent and .gitignore:263 excludes *.log.
openFindings.scopeProof: The three AC rows and benchmark rows name the missing path; git check-ignore proves it is excluded.

openFindings.title: The parent specification still counts six children and leaves the 006-to-007 handoff row undefined
openFindings.description: The metadata and purpose say six, In Scope and Files to Change stop at 006, and the final handoff row is TBD while the phase map lists 007 complete.
openFindings.scopeProof: rg over the file shows the seven-row phase map and the six-child prose in the same document.

openFindings.title: Phase 006's review evidence cites an absent report path and an ephemeral temp table
openFindings.description: The scope and dependency cite ../review/review-report.md and an absolute /private/tmp table; the report is absent from review/ and exists only in review-archive/20261019T144809Z.
openFindings.scopeProof: The review tree has no review-report.md; the archived report exists and the stale citations are listed by rg.

openFindings.title: The handoff command documents exit 3 as outside-loop only, while the CLI also returns 3 at the hop cap
openFindings.description: The command document describes only the outside-loop return-3 path; prepare also returns 3 inside the loop at the hop cap.
openFindings.scopeProof: session-relaunch.cjs has two return-3 paths; the command document describes only one.

openFindings.title: A crash between the stale-lock rename and its removal leaves an unswept lock backup
openFindings.description: removeStaleLock renames a non-file to .stale-<pid>-<uuid> then rmSync; sweepStaleTakeovers only matches the .takeover.stale- prefix.
openFindings.scopeProof: The only cleanup prefix in the module is the takeover prefix; the normal-path stale-directory test does not cover a crash leftover.

openFindings.title: shouldRelaunch treats a future armedAt as fresh instead of stale
openFindings.description: The age check only rejects positive ages; a negative now-minus-armedAt passes, so a backward clock step or future timestamp keeps the record fresh.
openFindings.scopeProof: shouldRelaunch is the only freshness gate; the wrapper and nudge both delegate to it.

openFindings.title: The carried-packet environment inputs are undocumented and differ by runtime
openFindings.description: Pi and OpenCode read SYSTEM_SPEC_FOLDER; Hermes reads HERMES_SPEC_FOLDER and passes payload.spec_folder; the environment reference lists no spec-folder variable.
openFindings.scopeProof: rg finds the adapter reads and the goal-binding reference but no row in the environment reference.

openFindings.title: The Claude and Codex nudge tests never cover a carried spec_folder
openFindings.description: Claude and Codex read payload.spec_folder, but their adapter test files contain no spec_folder case; the Claude seed test is the only spec-folder case.
openFindings.scopeProof: The two adapter files are the only automatic runtimes whose nudge field is untested; Pi and OpenCode set the variable in their suites and Hermes passes the payload field.
